Product Description

The Lee Men's Daybreaker Hi takes your style to another level. Bolstered by recognizable Lee branding and design elements. Let your personal style show through with every step as this hi-top features a mixed material upper, contrast stitching, and mesh molded comfort sock liners. Style and comfort laced into one!

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these sneakers to be of good quality, with one noting they exceed expectations for their price point.   • Struggling Nerd
    3 out of 5 stars
    Stiff and Narrow
    Reviewed in the United States on January 2, 2026
    Size: 9.5Color: British Tan/Chocolate
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I just got these shoes and don't know to what extent they will break in, but I would say I'm pretty disappointed so far.

    My feet are just past the length for size 9, so I went with 9.5, and the length is great; seems true to size in that respect. However, my feet are not particularly wide, yet these shoes squeeze the sides of my feet at their widest point, and the insides are uneven—there's a lump in the cushioning just below the left edge of my left foot. At first I thought I could live with it, but it started getting more and more uncomfortable, and it almost felt as if the upper edges of the soles were poking into the sides of my feet. I tried some inserts hoping they would bring my feet up just high enough in the shoes to rest above the edges of the soles, and that has helped to some extent—still pressing into my feet—but now they feel tight on the tops of my feet as well, so I have more experimenting to do. Is it worth it? Guess I'll find out... Really would have been nice if the measurement chart in the item description gave measurements for the ball of the foot; I simply wouldn't have ordered if I had known how narrow these are.

    I also want to mention that the edges of the cuffs almost feel a little sharp against my legs, and that's with socks on...

    Oh, and they came with a tag warning that they might stain light clothing, so be aware of that before purchasing.

    I'm giving them three stars for now, and that's mainly just because they look nicer than a lot of other sneakers, in my opinion, but... They really do seem cheap. Will update my review if necessary as I continue exploring whether I can make them work or not.
